title: The Waste Strikes Back
next_chapter_hook: Just as the experts of the two sects thought victory was assured, a will projection that transcended dimensions descended with a thunderous crash—it was the commander-in-chief of the Dimension Invaders, and for the first time, it looked directly at this so-called waste.

text.content: The crisp sound of the token hitting the ground echoed across the altar. Ling Yuan's pupils contracted sharply—the token bore a single jet-black vertical eye, coldly staring at him, as if it were the gaze of Heaven itself. Throughout the generations, Tianqing Sect master's tokens were all engraved with true dragons, yet this one... was a forbidden mark that had never appeared in the three thousand years since the Tianqing Sect's founding.

dialogue.content: Impossible... This token was destroyed by my own hands! When I pushed Chen Xuan into the Forbidden Grounds, I watched it turn to ashes in the thunder tribulation!

text.content: For the first time, Ling Yuan's voice lost its high-handed composure, his knuckles trembling slightly. The Tianqing Sect elders behind him exchanged bewildered glances—they had never seen the sect master so rattled. Chen Ji stood in place, robes stained with blood, disheveled, yet the corner of his lips slowly curved into a smile, cold as frost in the depths of winter.

dialogue.content: Destroyed? Sect Master Ling, what you destroyed was merely the first layer of illusion. The true token has been waiting for you in the depths of the Imperial Mausoleum this whole time.

text.content: Before the words even finished, twelve pillars of light suddenly illuminated around the altar. In each pillar, an ancient rune appeared—the sealing formation of the Tianqing Sect's founding ancestor, which should have dissipated when the ancestor ascended to immortality, but had been reactivated by someone. Ling Yuan's face changed dramatically: 'This formation can only be opened by the sect master... Who are you!'

dialogue.content: Enough! Why waste words with a waste!

text.content: From the Xuanwu Sect's direction, Han Lie could no longer hold back, a roar that shook the world. He threw out both fists, and the Xuanwu True Intent materialized into a beast silhouette that could devour heaven and earth, crushing toward Chen Ji. That was his signature technique, the 'Xuanwu Shattered Void Fist,' which had once shattered an entire sect's mountain range with a single punch. A waste? In his eyes, no one had ever deserved those three words—except himself.

dialogue.content: Brother Han, why so impatient? Didn't you say the waste isn't worthy of sharing the same stage with you? If you strike personally, isn't that beneath your status?

text.content: Chen Ji's voice was unhurried and calm, even as the拳 wind was right at his face, his gaze still as placid as still water. At that critical moment, the stone gate of the Imperial Mausoleum, sealed for ages at the altar's center, burst open with a thunderous roar. A dazzling, almost blinding light shot upward, shattering Han Lie's Xuanwu silhouette!

choice.prompt: The Imperial Mausoleum gate opened, and the sealed ancient power was awakening. The experts of the two sects were distracted by the strange phenomenon, their attention momentarily vacuumed—a perfect counterattack opportunity, but Chen Ji also sensed the danger of the power behind the gate. How should he choose?

choices.description: Facing the combined forces of the two sects head-on with the power released by the Imperial Mausoleum, crushing them with absolute strength
choices.visible_reward: The power of Three Realms Resonance displayed in full for the first time, shaking the world
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption too great, subsequent battles difficult to sustain

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes sparkled sharply as his hands formed seals, and the Tianji Record Fragment manifested dazzling golden light at his Brow Center. He would no longer hold back—three years of concealment was enough. In an instant, the power of the Three Realms surged into him like hundreds of rivers returning to the sea, a force so mighty that even heaven and earth trembled.

choices.description: Continue to feign weakness, lure more enemies into the range affected by the Imperial Mausoleum's power, annihilate them all at once
choices.visible_reward: Lure all core combat forces of the two sects into the trap
choices.risk_hint: May die on the spot if targeted

text.content: Chen Ji's body swayed, stumbling back three steps, a mouthful of blood spraying out, staining his chest. The crowd only saw the waste spitting blood, but no one knew that precise mouthful landed exactly on the core node of the Imperial Mausoleum formation—blood sacrifice, complete.

The rumbling from the depths of the Imperial Mausoleum grew louder and louder. A stone statue over a hundred zhang tall slowly rose from within the gate. The statue's face was indistinct, wearing a tattered imperial ceremonial robe, surrounded by three differently colored lights—red, blue, purple—representing the powers of the human, ghost, and immortal realms. The moment it opened its eyes, the world changed color, and the protective spiritual light of the two sects' experts dimmed by a third simultaneously.

dialogue.content: The Three Realms... the power of Three Realms! Impossible, since ancient times no one has been able to command the power of the Three Realms simultaneously!

text.content: Ling Yuan's expression changed completely. He suddenly realized something and shouted sternly: 'Everyone retreat! This is a trap! That waste has been setting up this situation from the beginning—' However, before his order could finish, the stone statue suddenly moved. It slowly raised one hand, palm downward, and pressed down gently. With just that press, seven core disciples from the Xuanwu Sect were instantly turned to mist, not even a scream escaping.

dialogue.content: Han Lie's eyes nearly burst from their sockets, his fists outputting frantically as Xuanwu True Intent transformed into countless black lightning bolts striking the stone statue. Yet those attacks, sufficient to shatter all defenses of a Golden Core stage cultivator, didn't even leave a mark on the statue. He was ignored so completely in direct confrontation for the first time, his arrogance finally shattering into pure fear.

choice.prompt: The stone statue's power had been fully displayed. The experts of the two sects fell into chaos. Chen Ji's layout had succeeded most of the way, but he still had the chance to choose his next action—continue watching them destroy each other, or personally harvest the results?

choices.description: Take action personally, displaying the true power of the Observer before everyone, shocking the entire audience
choices.visible_cost: Expose the existence of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan and Han Lie completely lost composure on the spot, shattering their arrogance utterly
choices.risk_hint: May attract attention from higher levels

choices.description: Let the stone statue continue to crush them, use the two sects to drain the stone statue's power, reap the渔翁之利
choices.visible_cost: One sect may have survivors escape
choices.visible_reward: Weaken the core combat forces of both sects simultaneously, watch the tigers fight from the mountain
choices.risk_hint: The stone statue's power may go out of control and harm innocents

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, coldly watching the chaos on the altar. Though the stone statue's power was formidable, Chen Ji knew in his heart that this was merely a breath of energy leaking from the loosening of the Imperial Mausoleum's seal. The real test was still to come. All he needed was for these self-important fools to bleed a little more.

Just as the experts of the two sects were being forced back step by step by the stone statue, a will projection that crossed the void descended with a thunderous crash. The projection had no physical form, only a pair of eyes—a pair of eyes condensed from pure dimensional power, coldly scanning everyone present, finally landing on Chen Ji.

Only three words, but those three words landing in Chen Ji's ears were like thunder exploding. The will projection of the Eye of Heavenly Dao—the commander-in-chief of the Dimension Invaders—had actually appeared in person. What did this mean? It meant the chess game he had set up had finally attracted the attention of the existence that stood above everything else. Ling Yuan and Han Lie were both stunned at this moment—they had never seen the true appearance of the Dimension Invaders' commander-in-chief, yet now they witnessed it nodding in acknowledgment... to a waste?

dialogue.content: Chen Ji of the Tianqing Sect, you are very interesting. This commander has remembered you.

text.content: With the words spoken, the dimensional projection vanished. Silence reigned over the altar, everyone frozen in place—the commander-in-chief of the Dimension Invaders had personally appeared and acknowledged a waste as a worthy opponent? Han Lie's face cycled through green and white, his mouth opening, wanting to say something, but found his throat seemed blocked by something. Ling Yuan's fingertips trembled slightly; three thousand years of scheming, three thousand years of endurance, all turned into a joke at this moment—the waste he had painstakingly suppressed had been personally named by the Eye of Heavenly Dao.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his hand, brushing the bloodstains from his lapel, his tone as flat as if commenting on today's weather: 'Sect Master Ling, Brother Han, and everyone else... the chess game hasn't ended yet. It's only just begun. Weren't you all so fond of watching the waste struggle just now? Now it's my turn.'

text.content: The Imperial Mausoleum stone gate slowly closed, and the power of the Three Realms returned to silence. But everyone knew that the waste they had mocked for three years had torn off all pretense. The personal acknowledgment from the Dimension Invaders' commander-in-chief was like a loud slap across the face of everyone present—including those Tianqing Sect disciples who had once coldly mocked Chen Ji, now all keeping a terrified silence. Only then did they realize that what they had mocked was never any waste, but a fierce beast awakening.
